title: A gate naming a tokenize module function (tokenize.generate_tokens, tokenize.tokenize) is still classed secrets
goal: SP-aoiqmnc6 review G3 (BG-hngdvqyy): TOKENIZE_WORD clears only a bare tokenize, tokenizer or tokenizing, so a gate naming the module's own functions (tokenize.generate_tokens, tokenize.tokenize(f.readline), tokenize.TokenInfo) still matches token and classes secrets; it fails closed. A gate whose only secret word is a name of the tokenize module's API is classed by its other words, and a gate naming an API token, GITLAB_TOKEN or a credential file stays secrets.

run:
import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_authority as a
it={'touches':['_tools/bl_check.py']}
qs=['Use tokenize.generate_tokens to find comments?','Does tokenize.tokenize(f.readline) read bytes?']
r=[a.class_reasons(it,dict(id='g1',question=q,options=['one','two']))[0] for q in qs]
print(r);sys.exit(0 if r==['design','design'] else 1)
